definitions.explanation: Guidance or recommendations offered to someone.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}から{助言|じょげん}をもらう。
examples.english: To receive advice from a teacher.

examples.japanese: {友達|ともだち}に{助言|じょげん}を{求|もと}めた。
examples.english: I sought advice from a friend.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}の{助言|じょげん}に{従|したが}うことにした。
examples.english: I decided to follow the expert's advice.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{助言|じょげん}を{聞|き}かずに{失敗|しっぱい}してしまった。
examples.english: He failed because he didn't listen to the advice.

examples.japanese: {良|よ}い{助言|じょげん}のおかげで、{問題|もんだい}を{早|はや}く{解決|かいけつ}することができた。
examples.english: Thanks to good advice, I was able to resolve the problem quickly.

notes:
{助言|じょげん} is a somewhat formal word for advice or counsel. It also functions as a する verb: {助言|じょげん}する (to advise).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {助言|じょげん}を{求|もと}める: to seek advice
- {助言|じょげん}を{与|あた}える: to give advice
- {助言|じょげん}に{従|したが}う: to follow advice
- {助言|じょげん}を{受|う}ける: to receive advice
- {助言|じょげん}{者|しゃ}: adviser, counselor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- アドバイス: advice (casual, everyday)
- {忠告|ちゅうこく}: admonition, warning (stronger, implies correcting behavior)
- {勧告|かんこく}: recommendation (formal, official)
- {提言|ていげん}: proposal, suggestion (formal, policy-oriented)

REGISTER:
{助言|じょげん} is more formal than アドバイス and common in written Japanese, business, and official contexts.
